Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our discussion, the team and I put together a short agenda and mutual action plan to make the pilot kickoff as frictionless as possible. Suggested demo slot:

- Thursday, Oct 22 — 10:00 AM PT (30 minutes)

Attachments: demo-agenda-30min.md (30-min agenda), noventis-mop-v1.pdf (mutual action plan / prep checklist).

Quick agenda:
- 5m intro + goals confirmation
- 15m live walkthrough (inference latency/cost overview + Redwood console)
- 10m next steps / roles & timing

If that slot doesn't work I can offer Oct 22 at 2:00 PM PT or Oct 25 morning. Let me know what works for you and if procurement should be looped in.

Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Noventis pilot demo — proposed slot and prep materials

Camila — thanks for the agenda and pack. Really appreciate the concise plan.

Quick update from our side: engineering just got pulled onto a product launch next sprint and the GTM team has frozen new pilots for the next 6 weeks while they push launch readiness. That unfortunately means we need to pause any new evaluation work, including the Noventis pilot we discussed.

Can we park the demo for now? Procurement is also on a short hold (Elena cc'd) so we won't be moving contracts forward until the launch window is closed. Would you be comfortable me checking back in around mid-December? If helpful, we'd be open to a short recorded walkthrough we can watch asynchronously when the team has capacity.

Appreciate your flexibility — apologies for the sudden shift.

—Samir

Samir —

Totally understand, and congrats on the launch push (hope it goes smoothly). We can absolutely park this. Proposed next steps to keep the opportunity warm without taking up your team's bandwidth:

- We'll set a tentative check-in for Dec 15 to see when engineering/procurement capacity frees up. If that date doesn't work we can push to Jan.
- I'll record a 12-minute walkthrough of the demo (no live ask) and share the recording + a one-page summary of expected latency/cost for the pilot so stakeholders can review on their own time.
- Marissa will add this to our nurture queue and we'll avoid repeated outreach until you give the green light.

If procurement prefers a note on contractual timelines to surface internally, Elena let us know and we can prepare a short outline for your legal team.

Recording: I'll send the link by EOD Wed (Oct 21).

Best,
Camila
